company.description: WheelsOn is a digital car rental platform, offering a diverse fleet that includes business, business SUV, and premium vehicles. Positioned at the intersection of mobility and technology, WheelsOn leverages a fully digital user experience to streamline car rental for both business and individual customers across the region. WheelsOn is focused on redefining car rental convenience and flexibility in the Middle East’s rapidly evolving mobility landscape.
